newsitem.title: USA: Rykoff-Sexton Q3 net shr profit $0.14.
newsitem.headline: Rykoff-Sexton Q3 net shr profit $0.14.

text.p: (Amounts in Thousands Except Per Share Amounts)
Thirteen Weeks Ended Thirty-nine Weeks Ended
There are no directly comparable prior year figures due to change in fiscal year and merger with US Foodservice completed May 17, 1996.

Earnings (loss) per share excluding amortization of goodwill for the thirteen weeks ended March 29, 1997 and April 27, 1996 are $.24 and ($1.52), respectively. Earnings (loss) per share excluding amortization of goodwill for the thirty-nine weeks ended March 29, 1997 and April 27, 1996 are $.63 and $(1.26) respectively.
Earnings (loss) per share excluding the charge for the impairment of long- lived assets for the thirteen weeks ended April 27, 1996 is $(.34).
Earnings (loss) per share excluding the charge for the impairment of long- lived assets and reversal of restructuring reserve of $6.4 million for the thirty-nine weeks ended April 27, 1996 is $(.37)
(a) Includes reclassification of certain items previously in operating expenses to cost of sales to conform the accounting treatment of the company and US Foodservice.
(b) Includes the charge for the impairment of long-lived assets of $29.7 million.
(c) Net of reversal of restructuring reserve of $6.4 million and charge for impairment of long-lived assets of $29.7 million. SOURCE Rykoff-Sexton, Inc.
